<explanation>
Based on the provided file tree and README, I'll explain how to create a comprehensive system design diagram for Mattermost, which is an open-source platform for secure collaboration.

1. Main Components

The system should be divided into these major components:

a. Server-side (./server/):
- Core Server
- API Layer
- Authentication Services
- Database Layer
- File Storage
- WebSocket Service
- Job Scheduler

b. Web Application (./webapp/):
- React Frontend
- Redux Store
- Plugin System
- State Management
- WebSocket Client

c. External Services:
- Database (MySQL/PostgreSQL)
- File Storage
- Authentication Providers
- Email Service
- Search Engine (Elasticsearch/Bleve)

2. Component Relationships

Draw connections between components showing:

a. Data Flow:
```
Client <-> API Gateway <-> Server <-> Database
                                 <-> File Storage
                                 <-> Search Engine
```

b. Real-time Communication:
```
Client WebSocket <-> Server WebSocket Service
```

3. Key Architectural Elements

Include these important architectural patterns:

a. Server Architecture:
- RESTful API (./server/channels/api4/)
- WebSocket Hub (./server/channels/app/platform/web_hub.go)
- Store Layer (./server/channels/store/)
- App Layer (./server/channels/app/)

b. Client Architecture:
- Redux Store (./webapp/channels/src/store/)
- React Components (./webapp/channels/src/components/)
- Actions/Selectors Pattern (./webapp/channels/src/actions/, ./webapp/channels/src/selectors/)

4. Plugin Architecture

Show the plugin system architecture:
```
Plugin Registry <-> Plugin API
                -> Server Hooks
                -> Web App Hooks
```

5. Detailed Component Breakdown

For each major component, include:

a. Server Components:
- Authentication Services
- Channel Services
- Team Services
- User Services
- File Management
- Search Services
- Notification System

b. Client Components:
- Channel View
- Team Management
- User Management
- Message Composition
- File Upload
- Search Interface

6. Integration Points

Highlight integration capabilities:
- Webhooks
- REST API
- Bot Integration
- OAuth Connections
- Custom Plugins

7. Security Layer

Include security components:
- Authentication
- Authorization
- Session Management
- Permission System
- Data Encryption

8. Deployment Architecture

Show deployment options:
- Self-hosted
- Cloud
- Docker/Kubernetes
- Enterprise Deployment

Use different shapes and colors:
- Rectangles: Core services
- Cylinders: Data stores
- Hexagons: External services
- Arrows: Data flow
- Colors: Different component types

Include a detailed legend explaining all symbols and color coding used in the diagram.

This system design should be created using a tool like Draw.io, Lucidchart, or similar, ensuring that it maintains clarity while showing the complexity of the system. The diagram should be organized in layers, with clear separation of concerns between different components of the system.

Remember to emphasize the modular nature of the system and how different components can be scaled or modified independently. This is particularly important given Mattermost's plugin architecture and enterprise deployment capabilities.

</explanation>
